title: Everyday Phrases — Joining a School Club
scene_zh: 加入社團 · 情境對話
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🏫 實用加入社團必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Joining a School Club
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用加入社團情境對話（從社團博覽會逛攤位、報名面試，到第一次聚會、一起辦活動、續社參選幹部），每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Joining a School Club phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), from browsing club fair booths and the interview to the first meeting, running an event, renewing membership and running for officer. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So what do you do together?
dialogue.zh: 你們平常一起做些什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a fancy camera?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the art club table?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你們通常什麼時候聚會？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five thirty is late for me.
dialogue.zh: 五點半對我來說太晚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can leave early if needed.
dialogue.zh: 有需要的話你可以早退。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you meet after dark sometimes?
dialogue.zh: 你們有時天黑後才聚會嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My mom worries about late events.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She can talk to our president.
dialogue.zh: 媽媽可以直接跟我們的社長說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is ten dollars per term.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay next week instead?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the fee include the trip?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I try a session first?
dialogue.zh: 我可以先來體驗一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When is the next trial session?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a notebook, that is all.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my friend sit in too?
dialogue.zh: 我朋友也可以一起聽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I feel out of place?
dialogue.zh: 我會不會覺得格格不入？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not at all, everyone is friendly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There are so many clubs today!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That loud music, what is it?
dialogue.zh: 那邊好大聲的音樂是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are they looking for a singer?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the chess club here somewhere?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is by the gym entrance.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You do not look like a chess player.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju du nɑt lʊk laɪk ə tʃɛs ˈpleɪər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I just guard the sign-up sheet.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dʒʌst ɡɑrd ðə saɪn ʌp ʃit./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many members does your club have?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈmɛmbərz dʌz jʊr klʌb hæv?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That seems like a nice size.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How often do new members join?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們在那做超好玩的實驗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你們的實驗會弄得很亂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am shy about speaking up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three times a month is enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 大家都是學生，我們都懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you keep your supplies?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that near the science lab?
dialogue.zh: 那個在科學實驗室附近嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I look around the room now?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ lʊk əˈraʊnd ðə rum naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在可以先參觀教室嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which club do you belong to?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 說實話辯論聽起來很可怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I keep changing my mind already.
dialogue.zh: 我已經改了好幾次主意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I take some flyers home?
dialogue.zh: 我可以帶幾張傳單回家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the line for forms long?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I feel ready to start.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you at the trial then!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A seat will be waiting for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə sit wɪl bi ˈweɪtɪŋ fər ju./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I sign the form?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a parent signature?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I practice with you now?
dialogue.zh: 我可以現在先跟你練嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I am Sam, grade eight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now say why you joined.
dialogue.zh: 很好，接著說為什麼想加入。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I forget my lines?
dialogue.zh: 如果我緊張忘詞怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不過我們社是週五聚會。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Many of us have busy Fridays.
dialogue.zh: 我們很多人週五也滿忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask a senior for advice?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æsk ə ˈsinjər fər ədˈvaɪs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask away, I am done here.
dialogue.zh: 你儘管問，我這邊忙完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 有什麼缺點我得先知道？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will club work hurt my grades?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How well do members get along?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was joining worth it for you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這是我做過最好的決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snap a photo with your phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it to the office teacher.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們會發郵件告訴你結果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I do not pass?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many people get turned down?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 把它當成揭曉前的期待。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the list go up yet?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My name is on the list!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 真不敢相信我這麼幸運。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything left for me to do?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my family come to shows?
dialogue.zh: 我家人可以來看活動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am so ready for this.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 第一次聚會馬上就開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the club meeting room?
dialogue.zh: 這是社團聚會的地方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I get here too early?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not at all, right on time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They are doing roll call now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say here when they call you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my name hard to say?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 負責人、小幫手和記錄員。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So what is our first task?
dialogue.zh: 我們第一個任務是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We design posters for the fair.
dialogue.zh: 我們要為博覽會設計海報。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then you sketch, I will write.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is yours, try it on.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I buy a second shirt?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the cabinet by the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我可以借用這些麥克筆嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Return them after you use them.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scan this code to join in.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I use my real name?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 偶爾有，大多是社團計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 已經有人按讚我的點子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I answer all of these?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的手機一直震個不停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I add a funny quote?
dialogue.zh: 我可以加一句搞笑台詞嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does a teacher check the drafts?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I show you my sketch?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I think it will work well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should the title go on top?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, make it big and clear.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you spell the event name?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me type it for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, glue it on the wall.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A shop could not do better.
dialogue.zh: 外面店家也做不到這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Post it to the group chat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 很高興你有被歡迎的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our club has a booth at the fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər klʌb hæz ə buθ æt ðə fɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我們社團在博覽會有攤位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, on the count of three.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold it, I will find a ladder.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɪt, aɪ wɪl faɪnd ə ˈlædər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們的展位看起來超棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 誰來介紹我們的攝影作品？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 如果我講到一半忘詞怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 有一家大小來到我們攤位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那就是我們最好的廣告。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這全是你們兩個撐起來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這個點子留到表決時提。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are on the renewal list.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sign yours at the Friday meeting.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your club family waits for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I run for a post?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You spoke well at the fair.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 而且你當選海報組長了！
